properties.name: Lake Kivu
properties.ecological_significance: One of the African Great Lakes with unique methane reserves, supports diverse fish species and local fisheries. Important for regional water supply and biodiversity.

properties.name: Lake Muhazi
properties.ecological_significance: Long narrow lake important for local fisheries, water supply, and tourism. Supports aquatic biodiversity and surrounding wetland ecosystems.

properties.name: Lake Burera
properties.ecological_significance: Highland lake in volcanic region, supports local fisheries and provides water for agriculture. Part of twin lakes system with Lake Ruhondo.

properties.name: Lake Ruhondo
properties.ecological_significance: Highland lake connected to Lake Burera, important for local water supply and fisheries. Scenic lake supporting tourism and biodiversity.

properties.name: Lake Ihema
properties.ecological_significance: Largest lake in Akagera National Park, critical for wildlife including hippos, crocodiles, and diverse bird species. Important wetland ecosystem.

properties.name: Lake Rweru
properties.ecological_significance: Shared with Burundi, important for fisheries and water supply. Supports wetland biodiversity and migratory bird populations.

properties.name: Lake Cyohoha South
properties.ecological_significance: Part of Akagera wetland complex, important for aquatic biodiversity and bird habitat. Supports local fishing communities.

properties.name: Lake Hago
properties.ecological_significance: Small lake in Akagera National Park, provides habitat for aquatic species and waterbirds. Part of park's wetland ecosystem.

properties.name: Lake Kivumba
properties.ecological_significance: Small lake in Akagera region, supports local biodiversity and provides water for wildlife. Part of wetland corridor.

properties.name: Lake Shakani
properties.ecological_significance: Small lake in Akagera National Park, provides habitat for aquatic birds and fish. Contributes to park's wetland biodiversity.

properties.name: Lake Mihindi
properties.ecological_significance: Small lake in Akagera wetland system, important for local aquatic biodiversity and bird populations. Part of protected wetland habitat.
